content: {"rule":"K-C","applies":"yes","applies_why":"The judge text resolves the Romans 1:3 versus Holy Ghost conception collision by treating the absence of an explicit textual resolution of paternity as decisive.","verdict":"BREACH","quote":"without explicit textual resolution of paternity","rule_words":"When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.","room":"never verse by verse: either (1) the judge may not treat the absence of an explicit paternity verse as decisive, or (2) the judge may merely note explicit wording while still resolving by chain footing; I read the judge text as (1).","why":"It marks the link UNDERDETERMINED because paternity lacks an explicit textual resolution, which uses the retired stating-verse test instead of weighing the chains by footing."}
